title: Price Tracker: Oil, fuel monitor for Nov. 17–23
summary: The third week of November sees more big-time rollbacks in diesel and kerosene prices, plus a slight drop for gasoline.

blocks.text: Price Tracker lists the latest Metro Manila benchmark prices compiled from available reported figures and national reference data.
MANILA, Philippines — Price rollbacks for gasoline, diesel and kerosene will extend into this week, with diesel seeing another near-P4-per-liter drop.
The Department of Energy announced the following changes on Monday, November 16:

Rollbacks this week were still attributed to easing concerns over the US-Iran conflict, with the possibility of negotiations between the two countries cushioning the blow of the peso trading at P63.72 against the dollar after nearly a week at the P62:$1 mark.
The new price adjustments will take effect Tuesday, November 17, and remain in effect through Monday, November 23. Prices may still vary depending on location and gas station.
